AbstractText.Label: REVIEW QUESTION/OBJECTIVE:
AbstractText.content: The objective of this review is to identify the impact of single room neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) design on infant outcomes compared to alternative design.The specific question is: what is the impact of single room design on outcomes of infants cared for in intensive care units compared to those in alternative designs?
